name: Identity Persistence
description: CORTEX — Persona injection from a persona markdown file, EWMA SyncScore drift detection, mid-context identity reinforcement, and observation extraction. OFF BY DEFAULT: when enabled it prepends a persona block to the system context of EVERY prompt and appends extracted observations to disk, so it requires both `enabled: true` and a persona file that already exists.

enabled.description: Master opt-in. MUST be set to true explicitly. While false the plugin registers no hooks: no persona is injected into any prompt, no SyncScore is evaluated, and no observations are written.

syncScoreThreshold.description: EWMA SyncScore below which persona is reinforced

personaPath.description: Path to a persona markdown file you wrote. The file MUST already exist — the plugin never creates, bootstraps or overwrites a persona. If an explicit personaPath is set and does not exist, persona injection stays off (it does NOT silently fall back to the default path).

personalityNudge.description: Also fold the AMYGDALA personality nudge (~/.openclaw/cognitive/personality-nudge.json, written by the Learned Intuition plugin) into the injected system context. OFF by default: it is a SECOND prompt mutation from a file this plugin does not own.
